authorityCutovers.reason: The frozen move-plan consumer census records only docs/repo-inventory.md and no executable consumer for this full-title acquisition lookup corpus, so its unselected rows were non-serving surplus rather than Reader facts. The exact frozen hash remains historical evidence. Selected questions, official roll identities, titles, tallies, verification facts, and member positions are independently complete in the two named first-seed files and now advance only through the federal-key-votes production candidate/promotion contract.

supersededHoldings.reason: The three-state ZIP index named a government for a ZIP only where this repository had committed its polygon, so it held 279 ZIPs in three states. Sean's direction (2026-09-23) is to track every area without a code change: the national index built by scripts/build-zip-division-shards.mts carries every division reaching each of the country's 33,791 ZIP codes, one shard per two-digit ZIP prefix, and every reader of the old file now reads it. The exact frozen bytes are kept as the baseline that build and tests/zip-division-shards.test.ts compare against, so no ZIP loses a division the committed geometry still carries.

The gap ledger was a committed snapshot of the meetings-discovery needs derived from the jurisdiction registries, for a hard-coded list of pilot ZIPs. The approved plan's CH-21 (2026-10-05) retires it: the free discovery walk now takes the calendar blanks of every Send's mission map, derived at run time from the same registries under data/states/<st>/jurisdictions/ and the promoted registrations, and an old jurisdiction meetings row retires only when its body holds a calendar route on the owed rows. The exact frozen bytes are kept as a test baseline.

rule: Finite session denominator: exact base SHA plus these committed external readback bytes. Later discoveries create future manifest obligations; they do not enlarge this session's denominator unless they falsify A1/A2 or are introduced regressions.

classificationCorrections.reason: A1 was falsified by canonical source-backed civic data embedded in TypeScript. The exact same session base is reclassified; no later acquisition expanded scope.
